name: Uruguay (1828–1830)
description: Nineteen alternating horizontal stripes of white and light blue with a white canton bearing the yellow Sun of May.
history: First flag of independent Uruguay, approved on 16 December 1828 and adopted by law on 18 December 1828 after the Preliminary Peace Convention with Brazil created the new state. It had nineteen stripes for the nine departments and the provinces of the former Argentine confederation; a law of 11 July 1830 reduced them to nine, the flag in force when the 1830 constitution was sworn.
